help.title: Authoring help
help.description: Syntax, components and settings of a presentation.
help.layoutsIntro: Settings of {annotation} and their values, which the Layout button of the toolbar also writes:
help.completionTriggers: Type {components} or {annotations}, or press Ctrl + Space in the header, to see the suggestions.
help.splitHeading: Each ## heading starts a slide. To split at the --- lines, write {other} in the front matter.
help.splitSeparator: Each --- line starts a slide. To split at the ## headings, write {other} in the front matter.

structure.headingTitle: # Title: first slide, title of the presentation
structure.headingVertical: ### Title: slide placed under the previous one
structure.separatorVertical: ----: slide placed under the previous one

mediaText.label: Media + text
mediaText.description: Text on the left, image on the right, each on half of the slide

fullScreenImage.label: Full-screen image
fullScreenImage.description: Image behind the heading, under a dark veil

storybookGallery.label: Storybook gallery
storybookGallery.description: Title + two Storybook screens side by side

root.title: Title of the presentation
root.parser: Splitting into slides: separator (--- lines) or heading (headings)
root.lang: Language of the document; French typography applies in fr
root.project: Catalog folder; for a presentation created in the studio, choose it in Settings and sharing
root.status: Visibility; for a presentation created in the studio, set it in Settings and sharing
root.unlisted: Reachable by link but absent from the catalog; for a presentation created in the studio, set it in Settings and sharing
root.storybook: Address of the published Storybook, without iframe.html, used by ::StoryFrame and by the story option of :layout
root.code: Colors and font size of the code blocks: a theme (nuit, sombre, clair) or its settings
root.reveal: Display settings of Reveal.js, the engine of the presentations: format, numbering, transitions…
root.accessPassword: Password of the semi-private visibility; for a presentation created in the studio, enter it in Settings and sharing

backgrounds.h2: Background of the sections: a ## heading alone or with one short paragraph

code.theme: Starting code theme, which the other settings modify
code.border: Border of the code blocks (CSS border property)
code.size: Minimum code font size, in slide pixels (960 × 700)
code.dim: Opacity of the lines outside the active area of a JsonTour
code.activeBackground: Background of the active area of a JsonTour
code.activeBar: Bar of the active area of a JsonTour

reveal.width: Reference width of a slide, in pixels
reveal.height: Reference height of a slide, in pixels
reveal.margin: Margin around the slide, as a fraction of its size
reveal.slideNumber: Slide number: c/t (current/total), h.v, c, or false
reveal.fragments: Shows fragments one at a time
reveal.fragmentInURL: Writes the current fragment into the address
reveal.loop: Returns to the first slide after the last one
reveal.navigationMode: Keyboard navigation: default, linear or grid
reveal.showNotes: Shows the speaker notes to everyone
reveal.pdfMaxPagesPerSlide: Maximum pages per slide in the PDF export
reveal.pdfSeparateFragments: One page per fragment in the PDF export

shortcuts.saveDraft: Save the draft and capture a snapshot
shortcuts.captureSnapshot: Capture a snapshot of the draft
shortcuts.formatJson: Format the JSON block under the cursor (otherwise all of them)
